title: Have Faith in God
lyrics_original: Have faith in God when your pathway is lonely,
He sees and knows all the way you have trod;
Never alone are the least of His children;
Have faith in God, have faith in God.
Have faith in God, He's on His throne;
Have faith in God, He watches o'er His own;
He cannot fail, He must prevail;
Have faith in God, have faith in God.
Have faith in God when your prayers are unanswered,
Your earnest plea He will never forget;
Wait on the Lord, trust His Word and be patient,
Have faith in God, He'll answer yet.
Have faith in God, He's on His throne;
Have faith in God, He watches o'er His own;
He cannot fail, He must prevail;
Have faith in God, have faith in God.
Have faith in God in your pain and your sorrow,
His heart is touched with your grief and despair;
Cast all your cares and your burdens upon Him,
And leave them there, oh, leave them there.
Have faith in God, He's on His throne;
Have faith in God, He watches o'er His own;
He cannot fail, He must prevail;
Have faith in God, have faith in God.
Have faith in God though all else fail about you;
Have faith in God, He provides for His own;
He cannot fail though all kingdoms shall perish,
He rules, He reigns upon His throne.
Have faith in God, He's on His throne;
Have faith in God, He watches o'er His own;
He cannot fail, He must prevail;
Have faith in God, have faith in God.

bible_verses.english: Now faith is assurance of things hoped for, proof of things not seen.
Be strong and courageous, don’t be afraid or scared of them; for Yahweh your God is he who goes with you. He will not fail you nor forsake you.”
He will not allow your foot to be moved. He who keeps you will not slumber. Behold, he who keeps Israel will neither slumber nor sleep.

devotional.prayer_english: Lord God, thank You for watching over me even when my path feels uncertain and lonely. When my prayers seem unanswered and my strength wanes, remind my heart that You remain sovereign on Your throne. Help me to place my trust in Your unfailing love and steadfast promises. I anchor my heart in the truth that You hear every quiet plea and will never leave my side. In Jesus' name, Amen.

devotional.reflection_english: Life often leads us through quiet, lonely seasons where our prayers seem to linger unanswered. Yet this beloved hymn reminds us that we are never forgotten; the God who sits on the throne holds our every step in His loving care. Even when we cannot see the road ahead, we can rest knowing that He never slumbers nor fails. May you find peace today in trusting His unshakeable faithfulness, resting securely in the love of Christ who walks beside you.
